name: dual-axis-guard
title: Dual Axis Guard
description: Catches zero baselines at different heights and independent ranges that make a +15% line and a +140% line climb together, states each series' real change, and offers one-tap "index both to 100" on one scale (your chart library via render prop, or built-in SVG).

meta.summary: Shows how much each series in a dual-axis chart really changed and offers to index both to 100, so the chart doesn't imply a correlation that isn't there.
catches: Zero baselines at different heights on the two axes
Independent ranges that make different growth rates look identical
Each series' real change, stated in the summary
limits: Indexing to 100 needs a positive value at the index point
It flags misleading scales, not whether the series are actually related
a11y: A text summary of each series' change, linked to the chart
The scrubber is a role="slider" with arrow and Page Up/Down keys
Legend swatches are aria-hidden; series are named in text
